chunk.content: In snack sticks made from kembung (Rastrelliger kanagurta), the stick made from the fish meat was preferred for texture.
chunk.source_quote: Fish meat stick favored in texture

source.title: Pemanfaatan Daging dan Tulang Ikan Kembung (Rastrelliger kanagurta) dalam Pembuatan Camilan Stik (Jurnal Teknologi Hasil Pertanian, doi:10.20961/jthp.v10i1.17492)
